<!--
  The aside at the end of a page head: one large figure with its caption, a note card with a glyph, or four key
  facts as cards in two columns.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { PageExtras } from "../blocks/page-trail.types";

  export type PageAsideProps = {
    extras: PageExtras;
    mode?: "none" | "figure" | "note" | "facts";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";

  let { extras, mode = "figure" }: PageAsideProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((mode as string) === "figure")}
  <Stack gap="0" align="end" class="text-end" data-testid="page-figure">
    <Text size="4xl" weight="bold">
      {extras.value}
    </Text>
    <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
      {extras.caption}
    </Text>
  </Stack>
{/if}
{#if ((mode as string) === "note")}
  <Group
    gap="4"
    align="start"
    class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border max-w-xs p-4"
    data-testid="page-note"
  >
    <LucideIcon name={extras.icon} size={20} />
    <Stack gap="0">
      <Text size="lg" weight="bold">
        {extras.value}
      </Text>
      <Text size="sm" weight="medium">
        {extras.caption}
      </Text>
      <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {extras.note}
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  </Group>
{/if}
{#if ((mode as string) === "facts")}
  <Box class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
    {#each extras.facts as s, i (s.id)}
      {#if (i < 4)}
        <Stack gap="0" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" data-testid="page-fact">
          <Text size="lg" weight="bold">
            {s.value}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" weight="medium">
            {s.label}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {s.hint}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      {/if}
    {/each}
  </Box>
{/if}
